curated-gf-langar-gf-actor: Commanding and loud, Langar leads with letters that never thin out. Actor follows in a plain sans with wide, barely curled s shapes, a quiet, modern texture that would hold up over a longer passage (basketball jersey lettering aside).
curated-gf-langar-gf-iosevka-charon: Langar swings big, with every stroke drawn at full strength. Iosevka Charon is the opposite temperament, a monospace body of fixed-width, open-sided letters that lays down a constant stripe of ink and rewards patient, technical reading.
curated-gf-lavishly-yours-gf-science-got: Modest little lowercase shapes, like chalk dots, give Lavishly Yours its friendly handwritten feel. Science Gothic sits beside it with sans strokes that stay wide apart and uniform, so the two feel like a warm note beside a steady voice, maybe on a war letters keepsake.
curated-gf-league-script-gf-alkalami: Fat stems, hairline flags. League Script writes like a casual hand, while Alkalami, a text serif, brings a middling stroke spread and a lower, more traditional authority that the handwritten heading simply doesn't aim for.
curated-gf-lemon-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads literary and refined, with oversized lowercase forms. Lemon above it is bolder, an almost circular c and slim joins that stay sturdy, and the serif underneath gives a longer passage a warm, bookish pace (say, for a camping gear brand).
curated-gf-libertinus-keyboard-fs-nunito: Commanding is how Libertinus Keyboard arrives, towering and pinched shut. Nunito, in a friendly sans-serif, opens everything back up with round bowls and terminals that finish well clear of the stem, and that open-versus-closed tension is the pair's real hook.
curated-gf-libertinus-keyboard-gf-jaldi: Towering lowercase with curls that pinch shut: that is Libertinus Keyboard. Jaldi, a plain sans, answers with a high x-height and a visibly gaping c, so a longer stretch feels brushed on and breathable, say on a cycling team kit.
